findings.finding: The first prototype was marker-heavy and should not be described as broad real-page visual discovery.
findings.remediation: Kept the lane explicitly fixture-assisted and discovery-only. The report and backlog now state that real OCR/pixel/AX discovery for arbitrary pages remains open.

findings.finding: Alternative detection was too shallow: any label/nearby text could suppress a candidate even when adequacy was not proven.
findings.remediation: Split alternative facts into alternativeDeclared, decorativeDeclared, nonColorCueDeclared, and alternativeAdequacyProven. Candidates are suppressed only by decorative declaration or proven adequate alternative metadata/non-color cue in the controlled fixture set.

findings.finding: Some positive examples were semantically weak because the visible meaning was also present as ordinary DOM text.
findings.remediation: Strengthened background-image/pseudo text positives so the target has no DOM text or accessible label, and changed color-only positives from 'Overdue invoice' text to 'Invoice' plus a color-only square.

findings.finding: Prompt packets could still invite LIKELY_BARRIER for a discovery-only lane.
findings.remediation: Discovery-only prompt generation now sets allowedVerdicts to ['UNCERTAIN'] and includes an explicit rule that downstream conformance evidence is required before barrier or clear verdicts.

findings.finding: SC routing mixed raw combined strings with normalized primary SCs.
findings.remediation: Packets now carry normalized primary sc plus rawSc and relatedScs for follow-up scope. The lane remains sidecar-only, so raw multi-SC routing cannot publish a conformance verdict.

remainingLimitations: The detector is still marker/element assisted; it is not general real-page OCR, canvas semantic extraction, SVG understanding, or full-page vision discovery.
Adequate-alternative suppression relies on controlled fixture metadata. In the wild, adequacy must be judged downstream by a rubric/LLM/human, not by this sidecar.
A visual-content packet is a review target only. It must not publish LIKELY_BARRIER, LIKELY_OK, pass, or fail without a registered downstream conformance mechanism.
Absence of a visual-content packet is scoped silence, never evidence that 1.1.1, 1.4.1, or 1.4.5 pass.
